image_description: A low-resolution image of a vintage white electric typewriter. The view is angled from the front-right, showing the paper carriage at the top and the keyboard deck below. The focus is on the entire machine rather than a specific component.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows a full typewriter, not an isolated space bar. While the space bar exists on the keyboard, it does not span the 'full width' of the device; it is merely the longest key in the center.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Length is dramatically greater than any other key, roughly ten times the width of a standard letter key.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Relative to the adjacent keys on this specific typewriter model, the space bar is significantly longer, fitting the proportional description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Typically white, black, or gray to match keyboard color scheme.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Part of a standard computer or typewriter keyboard.

Due to the low resolution, individual key boundaries bleed into one another slightly, and the texture lacks the crisp definition expected of a high-quality product shot.
